motion.name: modal-open
motion.purpose: Native dialog entry; hiding cancels local animation.

motion.name: popover-open
motion.purpose: Native popup entry with bounded local anchor pivot.

motion.name: settings-edit-bar
motion.purpose: Local draft feedback; no remote-save claim.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: JavaFX reduced motion OR saved ui_reduced_motion; 40ms opacity .85 → 1; no spatial/scale motion
motion.purpose: Same state/focus result; sidebar positions update directly. Preference changes complete active helper motion.

motion.name: cancellation
motion.value: Stop prior motion, restore original translation/opacity and remove local scale/listeners
motion.purpose: Cancel when replaced, detached or hidden; never snapshot virtualized tables.

breakpoints.name: sidebar-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Below scene width, expanded navigation narrows from 202px to 194px.

breakpoints.name: sidebar-auto-compact
breakpoints.purpose: Below scene width, navigation becomes a 68px rail unless manually overridden.

breakpoints.name: header-compact
breakpoints.purpose: Below header content width, selector preference becomes 180px and Manage/Find Action use named icons. Header theme action remains visible.

nativeMaterial.application: Consumed glass-surface/glass-elevated/glass-highlight background paints on chrome and eligible overlays in both themes. Working sheets, fields, text, rows, selection and Window/Node opacity are independent.
nativeMaterial.disabled: Solid nav-surface chrome with no highlight/shadow; eligible overlay surfaces use bg-secondary. Geometry stays the same.
nativeMaterial.fallback: Bounded JavaFX paints, no OS backdrop sampling/blur, no transparent window or JNI/FFM dependency.
nativeMaterial.frontmatterSnapshot: Consumed material paints at runtime default amount 55. Opaque ui-panel/ui-control are semantic paints, not material alpha. Reserved unused material declarations are not promoted to primitives.
nativeMaterial.preferencePreservation: Existing app_theme (light/dark), glass_transparency and ui_reduced_motion values remain in place; app_theme also accepts system and observes JavaFX platform color scheme.

provenance.authority: User approval of the complete external 2026-11-08 preview, the request for Add inside Manage beside store name, and incumbent PRODUCT.md constraints.
provenance.directionCaptureLimitation: Contract captured after initial preview code. Approval-pending wording describes historical preview stage, not the later user-approved source adaptation.
provenance.directionSelection: User-pinned Apple / Liquid Glass; seed did not choose that direction.
provenance.seedScope: Recorded external preview exploration only; not a fresh roll for this documentation merge.

previousDirection.seedLimitation: Historical user-approved preview seed; local registry cannot corroborate original roll.

provenance.platform: Java 25 / JavaFX Windows desktop; HTML documentation/preview is separate.
provenance.nativeValidationStatus: pending; captures and native interaction validation ongoing at documentation snapshot
provenance.tonalRamps: Synthesized OKLCH display aids, dark to light, with reduced endpoint chroma. They do not add runtime colors; alpha ramps use underlying RGB.
provenance.componentTranslation: Self-contained dark/light HTML/CSS documentation translations with inline SVG. Native code owns layout, handlers and motion. No web backdrop-filter is included.
provenance.scope: Approved visual decisions merged into the root native design record; historical preview and product records preserved.
limits: No implemented shared-product-image route or browser View Transition.
Source token extraction is not runtime, external API readback, installer or Windows performance proof.

narrative.overview:
Liquid Glass Workbench is VN Code’s user-approved Apple-inspired direction adapted to its Java 25 / JavaFX Windows application. Pearl and charcoal grounds support floating navigation and a compact toolbar; opaque work sheets keep order, product and registration data as the visual center. Bundled Inter, one blue action family, fine rules and the supplied black VN logo retain the product’s identity without proprietary Apple assets.

Material is bounded JavaFX background paint with inset highlights and small chrome shadows. It does not sample or blur the operating-system backdrop. Light and dark themes share geometry; the saved material amount changes chrome and eligible overlays without fading text, table rows or the window. Contextual, interruptible native motion connects an action to its result while preserving the underlying working context.
keyCharacteristics: Pearl and charcoal grounds, blue action and focus, and written semantic states.
Floating navigation and toolbar around large opaque, virtualized work sheets.
Bundled Inter, shared line icons and stable control bounds in both themes.
Visible store identity, Add inside Manage, and the existing named delete confirmation.
Native settings with Light, Dark and System, material control and reduced motion.
Relationship-based JavaFX motion with cancellation and retained list context.

rules.name: The Shared Palette Rule
rules.body: Use the active theme’s semantic paints for common controls and data states; marketplace identity does not introduce a competing page palette.

rules.name: The Text Stays Solid Rule
rules.body: Apply material preference to chrome and eligible overlay background paints only. Text, working rows, control boundaries, selection and the application window retain their own paints and opacity.

rules.name: The Working Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use Inter weight and size to separate page titles, record titles and supporting data. Keep metadata readable without giving every cell heading weight.

rules.name: The Bordered Sheet Rule
rules.body: Keep opaque working sheets flat and separate them with tone and fine rules. Use the bounded native shadows for floating chrome and temporary popups.

rules.name: The Continuity Rule
rules.body: Keep the selected record, list and store identity intact through local feedback. Reduced motion completes the same state and focus updates without spatial movement.

dos: **Do** reuse the shared semantic paints and bundled Inter in both themes.
**Do** keep the active store and Manage visible, place Add inside Manage, and retain the named confirmation for deletion.
**Do** retain list virtualization, barcode/GTIN data and complete multi-item orders when adapting a surface.
**Do** allocate layout space for batch actions and let their controls wrap at constrained widths.
**Do** preserve readable focus, written status, truthful empty states and accessible names for icon-only actions.
**Do** retain existing appearance choices and respect both system and manual reduced motion.
donts: **Don’t** restore the overview’s removed metric trio or its reserved empty band.
**Don’t** replace the header’s store controls with the former FBS delay text.
**Don’t** apply material opacity to a parent node or window, or blur/fade the scrolling working rows.
**Don’t** add per-row entrances, artificial task delays or decorative animation to the working lists.
**Don’t** promise OS backdrop blur, shared-product-image routing or browser View Transitions from this native implementation.
**Don’t** treat synthetic screenshots, HTML swatches or source inspection as marketplace readback, Windows performance or installer verification.
